name: Threadline public design DNA
authority: This file and docs/design/THREADLINE_PUBLIC_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md are the design source of truth for the public site. The Birdhouse analysis under reference-analysis/ is historical input only.

concept.world: The Threadline Authority Factory — raw expertise enters as crates (EXPERTISE, STORIES, PROOF, OPINIONS, EXPERIENCE); machines transform it along a conveyor; packages leave for the market; a return pipe brings the market's response back; the next batch is better informed.
concept.thread: the expertise / idea lineage moving through the system (drawn as a single continuous ember line)
concept.machinery: Threadline's processing infrastructure (ink-outlined stations with flat fills)
concept.weave: market memory — repeated, relevant exposure shown as thread crossing the same buyers again and again

intensities.public: expressive, illustrated, narrative, motion with a job

roles.border: ink at 1.5px on paper cards; paperEdge for quiet dividers

colours.contrast: ink on canvas 13.9:1; inkSoft on paper 8.1:1; accent on paper 4.6:1 (large text / button fill with ink text where needed); signal on paper 4.9:1

label.use: eyebrows, station labels, stamps, crate labels

typography.emphasis: marker highlight (stampSoft background, 0 -0.2em padding) for the one phrase per section that matters

collapse.768: single column with side-by-side pairs only for stats

shadow.none: flat sections and stations use no shadow

shape.imperfection: stamps sit at -3deg; crates at ±2deg; hand-set label tags; nothing else rotates

illustration.fills: flat, from the palette; steelSoft bodies, paper faces, stamp for lights and labels, accent for the thread and one detail per station
illustration.perspective: flat front-on with a slight isometric cheat on conveyors (no vanishing point)

cast: Founder (the expert; open collar, holds a crate)
Operator (runs the machine; sleeves rolled, clipboard)
Scanner (a lens on a stand; research)
Buyer (the market; a small figure who stops walking)
Signal (a pulse dot that travels the return pipe)
characters.proportions: 5.5 heads tall, round heads, dot eyes, single-line mouths, no noses
characters.poses: standing, reaching, pointing, stamping, walking, looking back
characters.backgroundDensity: one station per scene on mobile, up to three on desktop

iconography.factory: custom SVG primitives above; never emoji

motion.principle: Every major animation answers 'what is this teaching?'. Decorative motion is limited to hover feedback and the idle conveyor.

triggers.conveyor: always while in view; paused when off-screen
triggers.scrollLinked: the machine section progresses with scroll via a passive scroll listener writing a CSS variable; no per-frame layout reads

motion.technology: CSS transitions/keyframes, SVG stroke-dashoffset, IntersectionObserver, one rAF-throttled scroll listener; no animation library
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: every reveal is visible immediately, conveyors and pulses are still frames, the scroll-linked machine shows its final state
motion.mobile: no parallax; conveyors run at half speed; one animated element per viewport

rules: no horizontal page scroll at any width
factory scenes reflow to a single vertical conveyor below 768
hero readable before any animation starts

cta.rule: one primary per viewport; the sticky mobile bar carries Apply only

nav.mobile: logo + Apply, drawer for the three items

forms.field: paper, 1.5px ink border, 12px radius, 48px min height
forms.error: reject text under the field, field border reject
forms.steps: three steps, progress as a thread filling

footer.wordmark: THREADLINE in Fraunces at 96–160px on canvasDeep with the thread passing through
footer.line: A managed content growth system for expert-led businesses.

clientCards.note: unchanged; the public system carries into the app only as type, focus rings and stamp badges

adminDensity: unchanged — tables, chips, filters; no illustration
claims: Every factual public statement must be VERIFIED in docs/site/CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md; synthetic demonstrations are labelled SYNTHETIC / ILLUSTRATIVE in the UI
